title: Reputation Inflation
authors: Apostolos Filippas; John Joseph Horton; Joseph M. Golden
eligible_reason: Descriptive trends in platform feedback scores across marketplaces plus a decomposition method using private feedback and text predictions to measure reputation inflation. No DiD or staggered adoption.
design_notes: analysis/*.R compute averages and trends over time (public vs private feedback, predicted vs actual scores); no regression commands. writeup/longrun.tex (manuscript source in package) has no DiD/event-study design; the private-feedback question is a single platform-wide introduction used as a measurement device.
data_files_note: Upwork feedback data shipped (90 MB); written comments replaced by 'censored due to NDA'.
data_provenance_note: Feedback sample with text censored for NDA.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); screened from README, regression inventory, main-results code and OpenAlex abstract. Package also contains the manuscript source (writeup/longrun.tex), checked for design keywords. Out of scope.
